title: tropaeolum deckerianum var. tomentosum
intro: Tropaeolum deckerianum var. tomentosum, commonly known as the woolly flame flower or tomentose nasturtium, is a perennial plant species in the Tropaeolaceae family. It is a member of the nasturtium genus, known for its bright flowers and edible leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tropaeolum deckerianum var. tomentosum include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions like pain relief and antimicrobial effects.
